units.source_text: 是的，昨天我见过被害人。

en.t: Yes, I saw the victim yesterday.

units.source_text: 昨儿中午的时候，我从关山到山科的路上遇见过他。

en.t: Around noon yesterday, I met him on the road from Sekiyama to Yamashina.

units.source_text: 他带着一个骑马的妇女来王关山这边走来。

en.t: He was coming this way toward Osekizan, leading a woman who was riding a horse.

units.source_text: 女人戴着面纱，看不清脸，只瞧见她穿着件像是红面蓝里子的夹袄。

en.t: The woman wore a veil, so I could not see her face clearly; I only noticed that she seemed to be wearing a lined jacket with a red outside and blue lining.

units.source_text: 那匹马剃了马鬃，是一匹桃花马。

en.t: That horse had its mane clipped and was a dappled horse.
It was probably about four shaku and four sun tall.

units.source_text: ……不过我是出家人，对这种事情了解不多。

en.t: But I am a monk, so I do not know much about such things.

units.source_text: 那个男人——对了，他还带着佩刀和弓箭，黑色箭囊里约摸有二十来只箭，这个我看的很真切。

en.t: That man, yes, he was also carrying a sword and a bow and arrows; I clearly saw that there were about twenty arrows in his black quiver.

units.source_text: 我真是做梦也想不到那个男人会遭此横祸，人生命运如过眼烟云，难以预料。

en.t: I never dreamed that man would meet such a sudden disaster; human fate passes like drifting smoke and clouds and is hard to foresee.

units.source_text: 唉唉唉，我也无法表达我的感受，太惨了！

en.t: Ah, ah, ah, I cannot even express how I feel. It is too terrible!
